# x-twitter-scraper_webhook (Resource)

Webhook endpoint management and delivery



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `event_types` (List of String) Array of event types to subscribe to.
Available values are "tweet.new", "tweet.reply", "tweet.retweet", "tweet.quote", "tweet.media", "tweet.link", "tweet.poll", "tweet.mention", "tweet.hashtag", "tweet.longform", "profile.avatar.changed", "profile.banner.changed", "profile.name.changed", "profile.username.changed", "profile.bio.changed", "profile.location.changed", "profile.url.changed", "profile.verified.changed", "profile.protected.changed", "profile.pinned_tweet.changed", "profile.unavailable.changed", "tweet.deleted", "broadcast.started", "space.started", "following.added", "following.removed", "follower.added", "follower.removed", "profile.followers.changed", "profile.following.changed", "post.reply.new", "post.quote.new", "post.likes.changed", "post.retweets.changed", "post.replies.changed", "post.quotes.changed", "post.bookmarks.changed", "post.views.changed", "post.edited" and "post.deleted".
- `url` (String) HTTPS URL

### Optional

- `is_active` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `consecutive_failures` (Number) Consecutive failed delivery attempts since the last success.
- `created_at` (String)
- `delivery_status` (String) Endpoint delivery state. needs_attention means delivery stopped after repeated failures.
Available values are "active", "paused" and "needs_attention".
- `failure_hard_cap` (Number) Consecutive delivery failures that pause the endpoint.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Plaintext HMAC signing secret returned only at creation.
